run_aggregate_shards_stage: run the AggregateShardsStageService async to start MPC containers for aggregating private computation shard metrics
get_game_args_for_aggregation: get the game arguments dict for shard aggregation including input path, num shards, threshold, and metrics format
get_input_stage_path: get the input stage output path for the aggregate shards stage based on the current stage flow class
get_game_name_for_instance: get the MPC game name for a private computation instance returning SHARD_AGGREGATOR or PCF2_SHARD_COMBINER
get_status_of_aggregate_stage: get the latest PrivateComputationInstanceStatus for the aggregate shards stage service from stage state
